scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,worker -c blue,magenta,green "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run worker:supervised"
scripts.dev:api: pnpm --filter @fhara/runtime run build:functions && pnpm --filter @fhara/runtime run start
scripts.env:sync: node -e "process.stdout.write('[env] local backend needs no env sync\n')"
scripts.worker:supervised: node scripts/supervise.mjs --name worker --cwd packages/worker -- pnpm exec tsx src/index.ts
scripts.catalog:build: pnpm exec tsx scripts/build-builtin-skills.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/build-skill-catalog.ts
scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,worker,app -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run worker:supervised" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3000 && electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.check:guards: pnpm run check:budget && pnpm run check:cycles
